Recorded claim:
The expanded browser_contact_sidebar.js exercises all-books and single-book columns, picker changes, search, double-click, drag to recipients when drag service exists, To/Cc/Bcc buttons and context menu, deletion by menu and keyboard, and saved column state after reopening compose. It creates and removes accounts/books and clears compose xulStore state. The test names testSidebar and testReopenedSidebar state behavior. Later current code adds drag-selection handling, so check current test coverage before editing that path.

Provenance: 46cedf6cbff5e514074ff0c03f5684b523338f515193ca2c20e47d93a3970bc1. Original evidence IDs: 41773987b59886808dbc6de7d8b6dc305346fa9287e5ed918b4b37e0bf711629, 7d7dcd87e82565735d218b5d9aae76c99d3c0111dd79e97d00d64551aa40a03e, d5fb4555c2e660b7665d7ed35e2ecbf31d75dd5b569d5f4a43af090573c30edf.
This is a recorded historical interpretation, not independent source verification. Source quotes from personal imports or unconfirmed-access records remain private. Historical test results are reported outcomes; no tests were rerun for this backfill.
